name: The French Defense
description: The rock-solid strategic response to 1. e4. Black accepts a slight space disadvantage to launch a vicious counter-attack against White's overextended d4 pawn chain base.

chapters.title: Advance Variation (3. e5 c5)
chapters.subtitle: Attacking the d4 base with ...c5 and ...Qb6

steps.title: White Opens With e4
steps.explanation: White stakes an immediate claim in the center.

steps.title: The French Setup
steps.explanation: We prepare our central counterstrike with 2... d5, shielded by the e6 pawn.
steps.warning: The trade-off: Our c8 bishop is temporarily closed behind our pawn chain. We will activate it later via ...Bd7 or Queenside play!

steps.title: White Occupies Center
steps.explanation: White builds the ideal two-pawn center.

steps.title: The Center Strike
steps.explanation: Boom! We challenge White's e4 pawn directly. White must now choose: defend with 3. Nc3/Nd2, trade with exd5, or push 3. e5.

steps.title: The Advance Variation
steps.explanation: White pushes forward to grab space and lock the center.

steps.title: Target the d4 Base!
steps.explanation: The golden rule of the French Defense: ALWAYS strike at the base of White's pawn chain (d4)! If d4 falls, White's advanced e5 pawn collapses.
steps.warning: Never play 3... Nf6? here — White simply pushes 4. exf6 or traps your knight!

steps.title: White Fortifies d4
steps.explanation: White reinforces the d4 pawn with c3.

steps.title: Add Pressure to d4
steps.explanation: We develop our Knight and put a second attacker on the d4 pawn.

steps.title: White Defends
steps.explanation: White develops their knight to guard d4.

steps.title: The Triple Attack!
steps.explanation: The killer queen maneuver! We bring our Queen to b6 to add a THIRD attacker to d4, while also eyeing White's undefended b2 pawn.

steps.title: Attack e4 Again!
steps.explanation: We develop our Knight and pile pressure on the e4 square, forcing White to decide immediately.
steps.warning: If White pushes 4. e5, our knight moves to 4... Nfd7, and we immediately strike with ...c5 on the next move!
